rep_policy: One status per required method/seed/frame. Compatible cells require two warmup and five measured records. Incompatible cells have status/reason only and MUST have zero repetition records.
shape_policy: Every listed head and graph shape is required before training; no easy-shape selection. Unknown external shapes refuse explicitly.
